# B"H

Boruch Hashem
Blessed is He

# Mitzvah World Directory Index

Generated from the live repository structure at **2026-07-23T23:32:30.660Z**. This index covers **129 structural directories** and excludes AI-planning history, dependency folders, build products, coverage, caches, and Git internals.

The Awtsmoos renews the whole project every instant; this index is a finite map for humans and retrieval agents seeking the current vessels through which Mitzvah World is expressed on Awtsmoos.com.

## Start here

- For the live page and handoff context, begin with the [project root guide](DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md).
- For overlapping or disconnected implementations, use the [system overlap map](SYSTEM_OVERLAP_MAP.md).
- For programmatic lookup, use [`DIRECTORY_CATALOG.json`](DIRECTORY_CATALOG.json).
- For the current direct meadow path, inspect `index.html`, `experiments/Awtsmoos/src/launcher`, and `experiments/Awtsmoos/src/app`.

## Categories

### Application runtime

- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/app`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/app/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Application assembly, boot phases, meadow runtime, render fallbacks, player hydration, and high-level runtime coordination.

### Assets

- [`assets/materials`](assets/materials/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Material and surface-asset collections used to dress terrain, vegetation, and world geometry.
- [`assets/materials/generated`](assets/materials/generated/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Generated material derivatives and machine-produced visual assets. Treat these as outputs unless the generating workflow says otherwise.

- [`assets/materials/local`](assets/materials/local/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Locally curated material assets that can be consumed without an external asset service.

### Experiments

- [`experiments`](experiments/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Experimental implementations and supporting libraries used to develop Mitzvah World.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos`](experiments/Awtsmoos/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — The primary modular Mitzvah World experiment, including runtime source, tests, and tools.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Subsystem root for the modular game runtime.

### Gameplay

- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/gameplay`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/gameplay/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Gameplay-domain rules and coordinators shared by combat, action bars, progression, abilities, and player state.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/gameplay/actionbar`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/gameplay/actionbar/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Action-bar slot models, commands, activation rules, and presentation-neutral action selection.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/gameplay/combat`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/gameplay/combat/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Combat turns, melee, Torah abilities, cooldowns, targeting gates, progression rewards, and encounter state.

### Movie runtime

- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/movie`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/movie/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Movie runtime, timeline sampling, actor direction, camera direction, recording, export, and project execution.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/movie/audio`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/movie/audio/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Movie audio scheduling, synthesis, PCM handling, and capture support.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/movie/package`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/movie/package/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Movie package metadata and packaging helpers.

### Movies

- [`movies`](movies/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Movie projects, generated evidence, manifests, and tool entry points.
- [`movies/evidence`](movies/evidence/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Rendered or captured evidence grouped by movie run.
- [`movies/evidence/chossid-journey-30s-corrected`](movies/evidence/chossid-journey-30s-corrected/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Evidence artifacts for the corrected 30-second Chossid journey movie.
- [`movies/projects`](movies/projects/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Authored movie project definitions and timelines.

### Networking

- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/network`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/network/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Realtime transport, multiplayer session state, player snapshots, remote avatars, and connection status.

### Project root

- [`.`](DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Project entry, top-level audits, handoff notes, and navigation for the Mitzvah World game.

### Prototype

- [`experiments/animalMesh`](experiments/animalMesh/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Small experimental mesh-generation surface for animal geometry.

### References

- [`references`](references/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Reference snapshots retained for comparison and reconstruction.
- [`references/canonical-procedural-village`](references/canonical-procedural-village/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Canonical procedural-village reference files and manifest evidence.

### Rendering library

- [`experiments/light-three-gltf`](experiments/light-three-gltf/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Custom lightweight Three-like scene graph, math, WebGL helpers, and GLTF loading stack.
- [`experiments/light-three-gltf/test`](experiments/light-three-gltf/test/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Tests for the lightweight scene graph, GLTF, math, and renderer primitives.

### Runtime subsystem

- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/assets`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/assets/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Asset loading, catalogs, caches, material resolution, GLTF handling, and progressive fetch behavior.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/bundles`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/bundles/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Narrow bundle-entry definitions for selected runtime surfaces.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/camera`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/camera/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Camera profiles, orbit/follow behavior, framing, and camera-state coordination.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/collision`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/collision/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Octree storage, triangle geometry, capsule collision, raycasts, and step resolution.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/diagnostics`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/diagnostics/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Runtime observability, boot evidence, health receipts, and diagnostics serialization.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/diagnostics/logs`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/diagnostics/logs/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Captured diagnostic logs and runtime evidence. These are historical observations, not active logic.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/input`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/input/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Keyboard, joystick, jump, and UI-input adapters.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/launcher`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/launcher/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Page boot, route selection, menu loading, mode dispatch, and the direct shared-meadow entry.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/lod`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/lod/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Level-of-detail selection, distance policies, and scene LOD coordination.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/math`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/math/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Low-level geometry and spatial mathematics used by collision and world systems.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/motion`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/motion/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Focused motion primitives or helpers that do not own a full gameplay domain.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/performance`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/performance/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Quality profiles, budgets, timing, capability probes, and performance policy.
- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/render`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/render/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Focused rendering helpers outside the larger app renderer stack.

### Styles

- [`styles`](styles/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — CSS for loading, meadow HUD, menus, mobile controls, combat, game rails, and shell visibility.

### Tests

- [`experiments/Awtsmoos/src/test`](experiments/Awtsmoos/src/test/DIRECTORY_GUIDE.md) — Colocated subsystem tests and test harnesses for the source tree.
